title: Memberships
description: Who is a member, what they get, and who is about to lapse.
resumed: Membership resumed — the time it sat paused was added on.
cancelDescription: It stays usable until {expires} and will not renew.
cancelReasonHelp: This is the first thing anyone asks when the member rings up later.
emptyMessage: Sell a membership at the counter, or from a customer's record.
tiersDescription: What you sell, what it costs, and what a member gets for it.
noTiersMessage: A tier is the thing people buy — its price, how long it runs, and what it gets them.
tierArchived: {name} retired. Existing members keep what they have.
archiveMessage: It stops being sellable. {count} existing memberships keep running to their end date.
tierEditorDescription: Say what a member pays and what they get. The preview at the bottom is what they will be told.
fieldTierDescription: What members are told they get
tierDescriptionHelp: One plain sentence. This is what appears at the till.
priceHelp: What the member pays each period.
maxMembersHelp: 1 for an individual. More makes it a family or group membership.
guestPassesHelp: Free entries a member can bring someone in on.
fieldIncludedProducts: What an included visit can be used on
includedProductsHelp: Leave none selected to allow any product.
discountHelp: Taken off the list price wherever it applies.
autoRenewHelp: Off means the member has to buy it again.
fieldNoticeDays: Tell them this many days before
noticeDaysHelp: Nobody likes being charged with no warning.
